label: Делать
description: A full conjugation deck for делать: present persons, past, future, imperative, and common objects.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 1. 'Делаю' is the standard я-form with the -ю ending. 2. 'Домашнюю работу' is the accusative direct object. 3. 'Сейчас' anchors the action in the present moment.

Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 1. 'Делаю' repeats the я-form for fluency. 2. 'Важный выбор' pairs idiomatically with делать to mean 'make an important choice'. 3. A high-value abstract collocation.

Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 1. 'Делаешь' shows the -ешь ending of the first conjugation. 2. 'Уроки' is the plural accusative object. 3. 'Каждый вечер' frames it as a daily school routine.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 1. 'Делаешь' reinforces the ты-form. 2. 'Большую ошибку' is accusative; 'делать ошибку' means 'to make a mistake'. 3. A pointed corrective phrase.

Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 1. 'Делает' is the on/она-form ending in -ет. 2. 'Домашнее задание' is the fixed neuter phrase for 'homework'. 3. 'Мой брат' supplies a natural masculine subject.

missions.phrase: По утрам мама делает вкусный кофе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 1. 'Делает' covers the feminine subject 'мама'. 2. 'Вкусный кофе' is the indeclinable masculine object. 3. A natural kitchen scene set 'по утрам'.

Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 1. 'Делаем' shows the мы-form ending -ем. 2. 'Трудный выбор' reuses the high-value 'make a choice' collocation. 3. 'Вместе' frames a shared group decision.

missions.phrase: После обеда мы делаем короткий перерыв.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 1. 'Делаем' reinforces the мы-form. 2. 'Короткий перерыв' forms the idiom 'делать перерыв', to take a break. 3. A practical workplace phrase.
Strategic focus: Second-person plural or polite present. 1. 'Делаете' trains the respectful вы-address. 2. 'Ошибку' is the accusative object. 3. 'Простите' softens a polite warning.

Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 1. 'Делают' closes the present set with the -ют ending. 2. 'Сложную работу' anchors the sentence concretely. 3. Completes the six-person conjugation ladder.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 1. 'Делают' repeats the они-form for fluency. 2. 'Свои уроки' is the plural accusative object. 3. 'Дети дружно' pictures a group of students at work.

missions.phrase: Вчера я весь день делал работу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 1. 'Делал' is the masculine singular past form. 2. 'Вчера' and 'весь день' fix the time frame. 3. The imperfective past stresses the ongoing process.

missions.phrase: Она часто делала одну и ту же ошибку.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 1. 'Делала' adds the feminine -а ending. 2. 'Ошибку' is the accusative object. 3. 'Часто' marks a repeated, ongoing past action.

missions.phrase: Старое радио всю ночь делало шум.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Neuter past tense. 1. 'Делало' agrees with the neuter subject 'радио'. 2. 'Шум' is the masculine accusative object. 3. 'Всю ночь' trains the rarer neuter past ending -о.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 1. 'Делали' is the plural past form ending in -и. 2. 'Уроки' is the plural object. 3. 'Вчера вечером' completes the four past-tense forms.

missions.phrase: Завтра я буду делать домашнюю работу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperfective compound future. 1. 'Буду делать' joins 'буду' with the infinitive. 2. 'Домашнюю работу' is the accusative object. 3. 'Завтра' signals a planned, ongoing future action.

missions.phrase: Завтра утром я сделаю всю работу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. 1. 'Сделаю' is the perfective сделать with future meaning. 2. 'Завтра утром' marks the time. 3. 'Всю' stresses a completed result, not a process.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person. 1. 'Сделает' is the он-form of perfective сделать. 2. 'Окончательный выбор' forms 'make a choice'. 3. 'Скоро' emphasizes a single finished decision.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 1. 'Делай' is the informal command form. 2. 'Уроки' is the plural object. 3. 'Сначала... потом' gives a direct everyday instruction to one person.

Strategic focus: Plural or polite imperative. 1. 'Делайте' adds -те for respectful or group commands. 2. 'Перерыв' reuses the 'take a break' idiom. 3. 'Пожалуйста' frames a polite workplace instruction.

missions.phrase: Тебе надо делать домашнее задание сегодня.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Modal infinitive use. 1. 'Надо' takes the bare infinitive 'делать'. 2. 'Домашнее задание' is the homework phrase. 3. 'Тебе' and 'сегодня' express concrete necessity.

missions.phrase: Я очень люблю делать кофе по утрам.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Modal infinitive use. 1. 'Люблю' governs the infinitive 'делать'. 2. 'Кофе' is the object. 3. 'По утрам' turns it into a natural preference sentence with two verbs.

missions.phrase: Я не хочу делать такую глупую ошибку.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Negated infinitive use. 1. 'Не хочу' negates the modal and governs 'делать'. 2. 'Глупую ошибку' is the accusative object. 3. Combines negation with the 'make a mistake' idiom.

missions.phrase: В выходные я обычно ничего не делаю.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Double negation, present. 1. 'Не делаю' is the negated я-form. 2. 'Ничего' is the required negative object, giving 'I do nothing'. 3. 'В выходные' trains Russian double-negative grammar.
